data.long_meaning: The name Dayle is derived from the Old English words ‘dæg’ meaning ‘day’ and ‘leah’ meaning ‘wood’ or ‘clearing’. It can be interpreted as ‘Daughter of the Day’ or ‘Daughter of God’. In Christian tradition, this name symbolizes the light of God shining upon a child. The name Dayle carries the meaning “Daughter of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Dayle usually hope their child will grow to embody daughter of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
